description: Adaptive UI guidelines for the React website. Master matrix (persona × device × mood) + global defaults fill + soft TIPI trait nudges.
pipeline_order: Map questionnaire persona → master persona key
Bridge detected mood → guideline mood label
Fill missing tokens from global_defaults.json (Any/Any/Any majority)
Apply soft TIPI trait nudges from trait_modifiers.json (intensity only)
Apply device-relevant tokens + nudge CSS vars to the shop UI
extraction_notes: Master + global defaults are exported from Streamlit page 9. Trait modifiers are a fixed soft-nudge table (not a fourth matrix axis).
not_for_runtime: Do not call the Streamlit app or retrain models during browsing.
Trait nudges must never replace categorical master tokens.
